per_lemma.statement: ∀ (a b c : Nat), (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c
proofs:
intro a b c
induction c with
| zero => rfl
| succ c ih =>
  rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_succ, ih]
  rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [Nat.add_left_comm b (a * c) (b * c)]

intro a b c
induction c with
| zero => rfl
| succ c ih =>
  simp [Nat.mul_succ, ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]

intro a b c
induction c with
| zero => rfl
| succ c ih =>
  calc
    (a + b) * (c + 1) = (a + b) * c + (a + b) := by rw [Nat.mul_succ]
    _ = (a * c + b * c) + (a + b) := by rw [ih]
    _ = (a * c + a) + (b * c + b) := by rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm (b * c) a b, ← Nat.add_assoc]
    _ = a * (c + 1) + b * (c + 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_succ]
per_lemma.reference_proof:
intro a b c
exact Nat.add_mul a b c
